_comment: Reachable govulncheck findings that have NO fixed version and are accepted for now. hack/govulncheck.sh fails on any reachable finding not listed here (an entry matches by id AND module), and on a listed one once its review_by date has passed. Each entry names the path by which lo reaches the code and why that path is not exploitable in lo. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed version exists (govulncheck prints 'Fixed in').

ignore.reason: openpgp is unmaintained by design. Reached only in the lo-full build, through khelm -> helm's chart provenance verifier (armor.Decode); the slim lo does not import it. khelm runs that verifier only for a ChartRenderer with `verify: true`, and no lo addon sets it; a project ChartRenderer that sets it reaches openpgp. No lo render reaches it unless a project opts into that verification, so it stays accepted until helm drops openpgp. The fixed x/crypto version that the advisory lists since 2026-11-02 only moves openpgp into the module golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, which has no fix.

CRI checkpoint import/restore paths. lo-full links containerd v1.7 only as helm's OCI registry client (module import graph, init-time symbols); lo never runs a CRI service, never imports checkpoints. No fix in the 1.7 line.
CRI checkpoint import (image tag poisoning). Same path as GO-2026-5622: init-time reachability through helm's OCI client only; no CRI service in lo.
CRI checkpoint restore (CDI annotation smuggling). Same path as GO-2026-5622; no CRI service in lo.
CRI checkpoint restore ignores the destination security context. Same path as GO-2026-5622: init-time reachability through helm's OCI client only; no CRI service in lo. No fix in the 1.7 line.
